description: Pocket Tools is a Vanilla+ Quality of Life (QoL) utility mod designed to make survival adventures smoother and inventory management
body:
# Pocket Tools
Pocket Tools is a Vanilla+ Quality of Life (QoL)
# Features:
- Portable Trash Can
- Magnet Ring
# Crafting & Progression:
No custom materials required! All items are crafted using standard vanilla ingredients (Iron, Gold, Redstone, and Lava). Recipes will automatically unlock in your Recipe Book as soon as you gather the required vanilla components.
